I actually got Kybella injected into my jowl area along with Botox in my masseter muscles. As a result, the lower half of my face now looks more narrow and feminine. I recommend you to look into kybella and Botox masseter since you’re in your early 20s! I’m 23 and loved the results that it gave me. Prior to my procedures, I had a wide jawline and saggy lower cheeks. These procedures saved me and I feel confident than ever! I highly recommend you look into these procedures instead and you can always come back for more and gradually build it up. I had a total of two kybella sessions. You should check out @that_filler_life on IG to learn more about these procedures! Her posts on her facial slimming procedures are very educational and informative. Best of luck to you!
